name: v1.20.1
body:
## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.20.1
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

### Fixed

- **The fork-probe cache stays inside the project and out of git** — the cache no longer writes through a symlinked .gsd that points outside the project, and a fresh project no longer shows .gsd/ as untracked or sweeps it into git add -A. (#5757) (#5908)
- **Installs into a nested or unusually named config directory keep correct paths on every runtime** — the installer rewrote `~/.claude` references in several passes, and the converters that run afterwards (agents, the `gsd-core/` spec tree, OpenCode and Kilo commands and skills, command bodies, the Codex agent TOML) scanned the emitted prefix again, so a `--config-dir` such as `~/.claude/profiles/work`, `~/.claude.d` or `~/.copilot/work` was rewritten inside its own output, and `$&` in a config dir was expanded into the text around it. A Kilo install wrote paths like `.../profiles/work/profiles/work/gsd-core`, an OpenCode install wrote paths like `.claude/~/.config/opencode/x`, and a Codex agent TOML got `~/.codex` in place of `$&`. Each reference is now rewritten once and the emitted prefix is shielded from every later converter, for Kilo, OpenCode, Codex, Cline, CodeBuddy, Hermes, Qwen, Windsurf, Kimi, Trae agents and spec tree, Augment commands, and the Copilot and Antigravity `@` includes for a config dir under their own default home. Intentional changes to default-install output: (1) Windsurf global installs turned `~/.devin/skills/x` and `$HOME/.devin/skills/x` into `~/$HOME/.codeium/windsurf/skills/x` and `$HOME/$HOME/...`; they now give `$HOME/.codeium/windsurf/skills/x`. (2) Claude Code's own files such as `~/.claude.json`, `$HOME/.claude.json`, `~/.claude-plugin` and `./.claude-plugin` were rewritten into nonexistent names like `$HOME/.cline.json`; they now stay unchanged. (3) A Trae local install wrote `$HOME/.trae/...` and `~/.trae` paths, including `@$HOME/.trae/gsd-core/...` includes, into its skills, which point at the global directory; they now point at the project's `.trae/`. A comparison of real default installs of all 18 installable runtimes, global and local, against the previous build found no other difference in the installed files. (#5715) (#5906)
- **`effort sync --apply` no longer makes the next install back up synced agents as local patches** — the sync rewrote agent files without updating gsd-file-manifest.json, so the next install treated every synced agent as a local modification; the manifest now records the synced files. (#5683) (#5899)
- **Two orchestrators in one checkout no longer deny each other's sequential dispatches** — when parallel workstreams ran execute-phase in the same checkout, each recorded isolation decision overwrote the other's, so a plan resolved to run without a worktree was refused by the isolation guard; each dispatch's decision is now kept for its own phase and plan. (#5682) (#5891)
- **`drift-guard phase-status` and workstream progress read milestone-prefixed phases correctly** — under `phase_id_convention: milestone-prefixed` every `M-NN` phase named in ROADMAP Progress rows or STATE.md read as the bare milestone, so phase-status compared STATE against the milestone's first phase and reported a false drift, and workstream progress collapsed the milestone's phases into one. (#5675) (#5887)
- **`phase insert` names the milestone when the phase belongs to another one** — inserting after a phase that lives in a different milestone than the current one reported `Phase N not found in ROADMAP.md`, the same text as a phase missing from the file; the error now names the milestone that holds it and the current one. (#5679) (#5893)
- **new-project and new-milestone point to the right next step** — the closing hand-off said /gsd-plan-phase starts execution; it now recommends /gsd-discuss-phase, with /gsd-plan-phase to plan directly and /gsd-execute-phase to execute. (#5723) (#5905)
- **`phase complete`, `state sync` and init progress read milestone-prefixed phase ids correctly** — under `phase_id_convention: milestone-prefixed`, re-completing a phase such as `3-01` while STATE.md was at `3-02` rewound STATE to the completed phase, a first-time completion advanced STATE to phase `3` named "02: beta", and roadmap checklist rows, phase headings and phase directories such as `03-02-beta` were not recognised by init progress, init manager (its checked-phase fallback), `find-phase` (which reported phase `03` named "02-beta") and the planning snapshot. (#5676) (#5896)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/compare/v1.20.0...v1.20.1

name: v1.14.0
body:
## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.14.0
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

### Feature
* feat(#4422): block merging into next/main while the base branch's Tests run is red by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4428
* feat(#4593): add a macOS-specific conformance tier, final phase of epic #4589 by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4607
* feat(#4142): thread convention through the completion-path membership seam by @bshiggins in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3644

### Enhancement
* enhance(#2586): stop installing Codex context-monitor hooks without metrics by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4367
* enhance(#2618): render pending todos as one bounded bullet per todo by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4384
* enhance(#3085): add Grep to allowed-tools for 21 skills by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4397
* enhance(#4401): register workflow.compact_content as a validated config key by @bsmerbeck in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4441
* enhance(#4139): Phase 2 — one shared gate, one pilot split, one accuracy spot-check by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4471
* enhance(#4139): Phase 3 — partition rules + the five checks by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4497
* enhance(#4139): Phase 4 — measure the window instead of asserting it by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4502
* enhance(#4261): report size-cap headroom on every run, with a reserved margin by @drungrin in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4418
* enhance(#4209): optional external source reviewer lanes for /gsd:code-review by @davdittrich in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4323
* enhance(#4405): split the rest of the eager-window workflows worth splitting by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4536
* enhance(#4139): Phase 6 — the lazily-read remainder and the artifact templates by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4540
* enhance(#4089): add minimum-solution reasoning check by @lorenzespinosa in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4118
* enhance(#4285): resolve context-monitor fire-points from .planning/config.json by @behruznassre in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4366
* enhance(#3418): report real codebase drift instead of the whole repository by @funkadelic in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4124
* enhance(#4139): Phase 7 — the agent-skill seam picks the payload in code by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4553
* enhance(#4139): Phase 8 — the toggle becomes discoverable, and the ledger closes by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4587

* fix(#4130): parse phase-prefixed decision IDs (D4-01) by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/4357

## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.11.0
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

### Feature
* feat(#1954): flag undeclared coupling between same-wave plans by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3237
* feat(#1955): flag coincidental reliance in goal-backward verification by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3250
* feat(#1956): flag cross-artifact fact drift in the plan drift guard by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3259
* feat(#1953): complexity-triggered refactor extension point (execute:post) by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3261
* feat(#2870): resolve install scope as a value by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3278
* feat(#2871): resolve triggers and host precedence, not just placement by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3291
* feat(#3313): allow-test-rule total-file-count ratchet, F17 promotions by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3326
* feat(#3218): the prompt layer asks the CLI for plan counts by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3327
* feat(#1689): per-plan agent_hint executor routing by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3417
* feat(#3409): reject shell guards that cannot observe their own failure arm by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3558

### Enhancement
* enhance(#3248): disclose capability skills as an instruction surface by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3253

* enhance(#3242): validate codex .toml model posture, not just presence by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3290

* enhance(#2483): stop the claude reviewer lane from inheriting CLAUDE.md + auto-memory by @0xdhx in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/2493
* enhance(#3180): one code, one rule, one subject, with a typed remedy — Phase 11 by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3405

## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.10.0
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

### Feature
* feat(#2646): surface unresolved deferred-items.md at milestone close by @nabki in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/2983
* feat(#3072): ship the deferred MCP served catalog (resources + prompts) by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3083

### Enhancement

* enhance(#3149): dedicated init.debug entry point for /gsd:debug by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/3154

This pre-release is published to npm under the `next` dist-tag.

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.7.0-rc.6
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@next
```

This pre-release is published to npm under the `next` dist-tag.

```bash

```

## Install

This pre-release is published to npm under the `next` dist-tag.

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.6.0-rc.3
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@next
```

## What's Changed

This pre-release is published to npm under the `next` dist-tag.

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.5.0-rc.5
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@next
```

This pre-release is published to npm under the `next` dist-tag.

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.5.0-rc.4
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@next
```

This pre-release is published to npm under the `next` dist-tag.

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.5.0-rc.2
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@next
```

name: v1.4.5
body:
## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.4.5
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

### Fixed

- **`model_policy` is now honored on the default `claude` runtime** — including the `anthropic-fable` Claude Fable 5 preset. ([#1133](https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/issues/1133))

  Previously, setting a model policy (e.g. **`anthropic-fable` + `high`**) had **no effect** on the default `claude` runtime: agent model resolution silently fell back to `model_profile`, and no warning was emitted. The policy only worked on non-`claude` runtimes (e.g. `opencode`), so users believed Fable 5 was active when it wasn't.

  Now the policy resolves on `claude` too:
  - Policy-resolved model IDs are mapped to Claude Code agent aliases — e.g. `claude-fable-5` → `fable`, `claude-opus-4-8` → `opus`, `claude-sonnet-4-6` → `sonnet`.
  - A policy value that is already a bare alias (e.g. `fable`) is used as-is.
  - An ID with no corresponding Claude alias (e.g. a pinned `claude-opus-4-5`) emits a one-time warning and falls back to the configured tier alias, rather than returning a model the Agent tool can't spawn.
  - Non-`claude` runtimes are unchanged (still resolve to full model IDs).

  **After upgrading**, an `anthropic-fable` + `high` policy resolves the opus/sonnet tiers to the `fable` agent alias as documented. You can verify with:

  ```bash
  node ~/.claude/gsd-core/bin/gsd-tools.cjs query resolve-model gsd-executor
  # → { "model": "fable", ... }   (previously "sonnet" / "opus")
  ```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/compare/v1.4.4...v1.4.5

name: v1.4.4
body:
## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.4.4
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

### Add Claude Fable 5 as an opt-in high-budget Anthropic preset (#1014, #1015)

This release adds a new **`anthropic-fable`** model-policy provider preset that routes the top tier to **Claude Fable 5** (`claude-fable-5`) — Anthropic's most capable model (1M context window).

It is **opt-in and fully backward compatible.** Nothing changes for existing projects: the built-in `anthropic` provider and the `quality` / `opus`-tier defaults continue to resolve to **Claude Opus 4.8**. No project's resolved models change unless you deliberately select the new preset.

Why opt-in rather than a new default: Fable 5 is the highest-cost Claude model (~2× Opus 4.8 per token), so it is never selected silently — you turn it on intentionally.

### How it's enabled

Set your model policy to the `anthropic-fable` provider at the `high` budget. Either run the interactive settings flow…

```
/gsd-config --advanced
```

…and choose provider **`anthropic-fable`**, budget **`high`** — or set it directly in `.planning/config.json`:

```json
{
  "model_policy": {
    "provider": "anthropic-fable",
    "budget": "high"
  }
}
```

At `anthropic-fable` + `high`, GSD materializes this canonical tier mapping:

| Profile tier | Resolved model |
| --- | --- |
| `opus` (top) | `claude-fable-5` |
| `sonnet` (mid) | `claude-fable-5` |
| `haiku` (low) | `claude-sonnet-4-6` |

(The `medium` and `low` budgets of `anthropic-fable` behave like `anthropic` — Fable 5 only enters at `high`.)

To revert, switch the provider back to **`anthropic`** (Opus 4.8), or pin any model explicitly via `model_overrides` / `model_policy.runtime_tiers`. See **Model Policy Presets** in `docs/CONFIGURATION.md` for the full reference.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/compare/v1.4.3...v1.4.4

name: v1.4.3
body:
## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.4.3
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

A patch on top of [v1.4.2](https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/releases/tag/v1.4.2), fixing three `/gsd-update`- and orchestration-related bugs reported against 1.4.2.

### Fixed

- **`/gsd-update --reapply` no longer false-positives on post-rename installs.** After the `get-shit-done` → `gsd-core` rename (#604), the reapply verifier reported spurious `FAIL_USER_LINES_MISSING` / `FAIL_INSTALLED_MISSING` errors. Two gaps fixed: (a) the verifier now returns a non-blocking `OK_NO_BASELINE` advisory when a pristine hash is recorded but no baseline snapshot exists on disk (instead of falling to over-broad mode); (b) a new migration (`004-prune-stale-pristine-snapshots`) removes orphaned `gsd-pristine/get-shit-done/` snapshots that migration 003 left behind — a *new* migration, so migration 003's checksum is preserved. (#934, PR #937)
- **`/gsd-update` changelog preview no longer silently fails.** The changeset CLI was never installed into the runtime config dir, and `update.md` pointed at the wrong path, so the preview swallowed the error on every real install. The installer now copies `scripts/changeset/` and `scripts/lib/`, `update.md` uses the correct installed path, and a genuinely-missing CLI now surfaces an explicit message. (#935, PR #938)
- **`/gsd-plan-phase` replan in `plan-review-convergence` now works on Claude Code.** Convergence wrapped `gsd-plan-phase` in an `Agent()` call at two sites; on Claude Code a depth-1 sub-agent has no Agent tool, so the wrapped plan-phase could never spawn `gsd-planner`/`gsd-plan-checker` and the replan loop silently failed whenever HIGH concerns were found. Plan-phase now runs **inline** at depth 0 (where the Agent tool is available), restoring the planner→checker chain. A new structural guard test prevents any workflow from re-introducing the nested-spawner wrap. (#936, PR #939)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/compare/v1.4.2...v1.4.3

name: v1.4.2
body:
## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.4.2
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

A small patch on top of [v1.4.1](https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/releases/tag/v1.4.1), fixing two orchestration/runtime bugs on Claude Code.

### Fixed

- **`/gsd-plan-phase`, `/gsd-execute-phase`, and `/gsd-autonomous` no longer fail to spawn their sub-agents on Claude Code.** These orchestrators carried `context: fork`, which runs them in a forked context that has no `Agent` tool — so they couldn't spawn the researcher/planner/checker/executor agents they depend on (manifesting as a top-level `/gsd-plan-phase` aborting at planner spawn on a false-negative Agent-availability check). `context: fork` is removed from the three spawning orchestrators (their `effort:` budget hint is preserved), and the plan-phase Agent-availability guard is now **attempt-based** — it tries the spawn and only falls back if the tool is genuinely absent, rather than guessing. (#921, #922 — PR #926)
- **The context monitor now echoes the invoking hook event name.** It hardcoded `hookEventName: "PostToolUse"` even when invoked by the `Stop` / `SubagentStop` / `PreCompact` hooks, so Claude Code rejected its output with "expected Stop but got PostToolUse." It now reports the actual triggering event. (#925 — PR #927)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2

name: v1.4.1
body:
## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.4.1
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

A patch rollup of fixes from `next` on top of `v1.4.0`.

### Fixed

- **Top-level Claude Code `/gsd-plan-phase` now always spawns the researcher / planner / plan-checker agents** instead of collapsing them inline. A `<runtime_compatibility>` guard makes the Agent-availability requirement explicit and fails closed (stop + log) in genuinely Agent-less contexts; `--chain`/`--auto` suppress prompts only, never spawns. (#913, #915)
- **`validate health` / `validate consistency` no longer emit false-positive W007 warnings** for projects using checklist-style `ROADMAP.md` phases (`- [x] **Phase N: name**`), not just heading-style. (#892, #908)
- **`syncStateFrontmatter` no longer strips `current_phase`, `current_phase_name`, `current_plan`, and `progress` from `STATE.md`** when body annotations are absent — the existing frontmatter scalars are now preserved. (#905, #907)
- **`init execute-phase` and `cmdCommit` now build the correct `branch_name` when `project_code` is set** — `{phase}` is normalized and zero-padded (e.g. `gsd/phase-01-foundation`, not `gsd/phase-CK-01-foundation`). (#904, #909)
- **The `gsd_run` launcher shim now probes all non-Claude runtime homes before failing** (Hermes, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf, Augment, Trae, Qwen, CodeBuddy, Cline, Grok, Antigravity, OpenCode, Kilo), fixing a false-positive fatal error on those runtimes. (#891, #911)
- **profile-pipeline temp output now lands under the reaped GSD temp root** (`GSD_TEMP_DIR`) instead of `os.tmpdir()` root, so it gets cleaned up; adds missing test-fixture teardown. (#866, #879)
- **`/gsd-manager` and `/gsd-autonomous --interactive` no longer silently skip worktree isolation and independent verification on Claude Code** — they now run plan/execute inline on Claude Code (a backgrounded agent can't spawn the nested executors/checker/verifier). (#853, #863)
- **Installer no longer leaks `gsd-cmd-rewrites-*` temp directories** under the system temp root. (#856, #862)
- **Corrected installer `--help` profile skill counts** — derived from `PROFILES` so they can't drift again. (#834, #847)
- **`roadmap-phase-fallback` tests are now hermetic** against ambient `GSD_*` environment variables. (#872, #873)

### Changed

- Added runtime-install **no-drift guard tests** protecting the Runtime Install Policy boundary (ADR-58) and the Runtime Config Adapter Registry (#60). (#57, #867)
- Removed the unused PR-size labeler (`size/S–XL`) workflow. (#846, #848)
- Fork PRs without a pre-approved issue are now auto-closed. (#899, #901)

> **Note:** Two fixes on `next` — #875 (`getMilestonePhaseFilter` fence-aware) and #893 (remove dead `loadConfig`) — were intentionally **not** included in 1.4.1 because they depend on post-1.4.0 refactors (`roadmap-parser.cts`, `config-loader.cts`) that aren't in this patch base. They ship in the next minor release.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/compare/v1.4.0...v1.4.1

name: v1.3.1
body:
## Install

```bash
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@1.3.1
# or
npm i @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## What's Changed

> Note: the auto-generated changelog came up empty because this hotfix shipped via direct commits to the hotfix branch (no merged PRs in the `v1.3.0..v1.3.1` range). Manually documented below.

### Fix

- **Installer no longer aborts on upgrade with `applied migration checksum changed`** ([#670](https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/issues/670), [#675](https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/675)). Editing the body of an already-released installer migration (the v1.3.0 `get-shit-done` → `gsd-core` rename) drifted its computed checksum, and the integrity guard hard-aborted every prior install on upgrade. Already-applied migrations are never re-run, so the drift is inert — the installer now **detects and reconciles** the drifted checksum (`plan.checksumDrift`) instead of aborting, and a CI baseline test locks shipped-migration checksums going forward. This was a 100%-reproducible blocker on all platforms.
- **Resolved a moderate `hono` advisory** (GHSA-3hrh-pfw6-9m5x and related) carried in the v1.3.0 production dependency tree (bumped to 4.12.23).

### Internal

- Published via npm OIDC trusted publishing with SLSA provenance; the standalone hotfix workflow was consolidated into the Release workflow.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1

body:
> **Note on changelog history (2026-05-22):** Apologies — the unexpected migration from `gsd-build/get-shit-done` to `open-gsd/get-shit-done-redux` scrambled our changelog automation, and any auto-generated release notes here previously carried version numbers from the old repository. The numbering restarted at v1.0.0 with this move. Things will be clean starting with the next v1.0.1 release.

The list below covers the work that landed in the new repo through the v1.0.0 cutover.

### Feature

- isPhaseUatPassed predicate + phase.uat-passed query (#94)

### Enhancement

- rebrand npm packages to @opengsd scope (#127)
- migrate references from compromised gsd-build to open-gsd/get-shit-done-redux (#121)
- skip full test matrix on doc-only PRs (#110)
- add branch protection ruleset specs (#106)

### Fix

- case-insensitive depends_on resolution in phase resolver (#88)
- treat 999 as exact sentinel in phase-lifecycle-policy (#93)
- isolate --local install from global gsd-sdk (#89)
- handle milestone-scoped phase dirs in roadmap parser, phase.add, and init queries (#80)
- match all Plans-block variants in annotate-dependencies (#92)
- include all version patterns in changelog extraction (#90)
- expose adaptive in model_profile settings flow (#91)
- schema-aware log_to_state row appending in fast.md (#85)
- phase.insert handles checked-bullet ROADMAP format (#79)
- snapshot old release into gsd-pristine, not new (#87)
- replace wall-clock deadline poll in graphify-auto-update test (#86)
- codex adapter activates TEXT_MODE when request_user_input is unavailable (#84)
- port W005/W006/I001 false-positive fixes from validate.ts to verify.cjs (#83)
- detect project-local agents in init.* (local-first resolution) (#82)
- worktree.cleanup-wave rescues uncommitted SUMMARY.md (#81)
- escape '/' in forensics test regex literals (#123)
- escape colons in echo strings in CI workflow yaml (#125)
- correct status-check context order in branch protection rulesets (#112)
